import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for the invitation content. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {title_of_event}

{title_of_event}

Date: {scheduled_date}

{event_details}
{extra_info}
""" def create_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, event_details: str, scheduled_date: str, extra_info: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title_of_event : str The name or title of the event. event_details : str A comprehensive description of the event (may contain multiple lines). scheduled_date : str The scheduled date for the event. extra_info : str Extra information or instructions provided by the user. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string ready for safe rendering. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent XSS attacks (CWE-79). safe_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) safe_details = html.escape(event_details, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) safe_extra = html.escape(extra_info, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( title_of_event=safe_title, event_details=safe_details, scheduled_date=safe_date, extra_info=safe_extra )
